name: mimic_octopus
description: Mimic octopus (Thaumoctopus mimicus) at rest on sand, facing right: small banded mantle raised behind a small head, two small raised eyes with horizontal bar pupils under heavy lids (not cute), and eight very long thin arms banded cream #efe3c8 / chocolate #5b3a24, spread wide across the sand with curled tips. Anchor bottom-centre (sand line y 0); ~x -390..390, y -240..+10.
